name: Kamituga

queries.query: Kamituga Democratic Republic of the Congo official cadastral parcel map cadastre
queries.result: The official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs directory identifies the local land and cadastral jurisdiction as Mwenga-Kamituga. No public Kamituga parcel geometry viewer was found in the search results.

queries.query: Kamituga RDC cadastre parcelle carte parcellaire officiel
queries.result: Les résultats officiels indiquent la circonscription foncière et cadastrale Mwenga-Kamituga. Le Bureau d'Informations Cadastrales annonce un service pour le Sud-Kivu, mais aucune géométrie publique n'a été retournée pour Kamituga dans les requêtes bornées anonymes.

researchNote: An official Ministry directory evidences the local Mwenga-Kamituga cadastral/land jurisdiction. The anonymous BIC public table was reachable but returned zero rows for Sud-Kivu, Kamituga, and a tight bounding query around the exact WUP point; this is not evidence of citywide parcel absence. The official cadastre.gouv.cd host failed DNS resolution during this attempt. No parcel sample is retained. This packet is not source integration or runtime admission.
